tagline: Global leader in renewable energy development, build, own, and operate solutions delivering clean power across five continents
hero_kpi_rationale: 94% of Scatec's revenues come from activities aligned with the green taxonomy, positioning the company as a pure-play green energy player, a key driver for ESG investors and sustainable valuation.

kpis.name: Green Eligible Revenue
kpis.explanation: Share of revenues from renewable activities eligible for green financing.
kpis.description: Green eligible revenue reflects Scatec's direct exposure to solar and storage activities, the core of its business model.
kpis.signal: 94% of revenues are green and aligned with the EU taxonomy.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Consolidated total revenue of the company under IFRS.
kpis.description: Total revenue includes all activities, including electricity sales and ancillary services.
kpis.signal: Revenue almost entirely driven by renewable energy.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Consolidated gross margin of the company.
kpis.description: Gross margin is not mentioned in the Green Finance Report 2024. KPI removed following validation.
kpis.signal: Data not available in the report

kpis.name: Annual Equity Investment
kpis.explanation: Annual equity investment expenditures for new renewable projects.
kpis.description: Annual investment targeted at the development of solar, storage and hydro projects in line with strategic priorities towards 2027, aiming to expand the portfolio in key markets.
kpis.signal: Strategic target of 750 million NOK per year in equity for renewable growth towards 2027.

kpis.name: Operational and Under Construction Installed Capacity
kpis.explanation: Total renewable energy capacity in operation and under construction.
kpis.description: Installed capacity across fifteen countries, split between operating assets (4,221 MW) and projects under construction (767 MW), primarily photovoltaic solar with presence in Africa, Asia, Latin America and Eastern Europe.
kpis.signal: 5 GW split between current operations (4,221 MW) and projects under construction (767 MW), a solid foundation for diversified growth.

kpis.name: CO2 Emissions Avoided
kpis.explanation: Tons of CO2 avoided through renewable energy production.
kpis.description: CO2 emissions avoided based on renewable energy production from operational assets, totaling 4,100 Kt for the 4,221 MW in operation according to country-level allocation (Table 1 of the report).
kpis.signal: Measurable climate impact: 4.1 million tons of CO2 avoided from current operations.
